blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has retained its Tier 1 ranking in the US State Department’s annual Trafficking in Persons (TIP) Report for the 11th consecutive year, according to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Committee on Media Affairs and Strategic Communications in a statement on Tuesday. Tier 1 is the highest classification in the US State Department’s annual assessment, given to countries whose governments fully meet the minimum standards for combating human trafficking. The designation, however, does not mean that trafficking has been completely eliminated. The recognition comes as the country prepares to host the 20th Asean Ministerial Meeting […]...
